goblin_dynamiter.subject: a small wiry goblin with olive-green skin, long pointed ears, a narrow sharp-featured face, a dented leather cap and patched brown rags, running toward the right with a tense, determined face. He carries one bundle of three red dynamite sticks tied with twine tucked under his right arm, and his left arm swings forward as he runs, both bare feet clearly on the dirt. A short lit fuse sparks at the top of the bundle, and a little dust rises behind his heels. A broken wooden barricade stands at the far right edge.
